jobs.title: Senior Sales Executive - New Business
jobs.description:
About Smartnumbers

We are on a mission to stop fraud and improve customer authentication. Fraud is a huge problem affecting millions of people, it costs the UK nearly £7bn and represents 40% of all crime. Too often the solution has been to put in place cumbersome authentication processes that frustrate genuine customers, cause inefficiencies for organisations and fail to prevent fraud. 
 
We are changing this by providing organisations with real-time insight into the risk of a caller. We combine patented machine learning technology with our industry consortium to help identify and prevent contact centre fraud. We also provide clients with real-time insight into the authenticity of the call by leveraging our unique network access and relationships. 
 
We recognise that we need to work together to fight fraud, that is why we have fostered strategic partnerships with leading global organisations like Amazon, BT, and Genesys. Together, we protect some of the UKs largest banks, insurance companies and emergency services. We also believe in developing our people into high performing teams.


What you'll be working on

We're looking for someone to build out a long term 2–3 year strategic pipeline. As part of the role, you will be expected to do the following: 
 

  • Build and maintain a 12–18 month active pipeline to support business objectives
  • Build and maintain relevant market awareness through client discussions, market research and industry events
  • Provide senior management with clear updates, progress and forecasts as evidenced through the company CRM
  • Nurture the customer advocacy program in support of our broader business goals
  • Prioritise activities to meet quarterly business targets while maintaining a longer-term strategic pipeline

What you’ll achieve 

You’ll be helping us achieve our mission by enabling fraud investigators across organisations to collaborate in their fight against fraud using our SaaS platform. The types of areas you’ll look at include: 
  • New Business Development
  • Leading client facing discover conversations to establish key business issues
  • Understanding and navigating the different approaches to fraud prevention across different sectors
  • Helping Clients build business cases for Smartnumbers adoption
  • Sharing intelligence and best practice across organisations
  • Increasing market awareness by supporting events, posts or other GTM activities
  • Building trust and a network of advocates among your client base

How you’ll work 

You’ll be part of an empowered cross functional go to market team that leverages best practice and seeks continual improvement. You’ll be given the freedom to manage your own time with support and guidance from senior sales leadership. You’ll be expected to build, maintain and report on a clear 12–18 month runway of pipeline with dedicated time set aside each week for strategic focus and execution on new business development.


What you'll need for the role

Smartnumbers values diversity of experience. Candidates should have a strong combination of several of the following skills, competencies and experience: 
 

  • Numbers Obsessed – You live and breathe your pipeline and progress and take pride in its resilience and accuracy.
  • Curious - You want to understand the problems our customers face and how we might solve them. You’re always looking for new opportunities to learn about our customers, the market, competitors, technology, etc.
  • Customer Focused - You start with the customer and work back whilst understanding that solutions have to work for our business
  • Outcome focused - You can define what success looks like and measure progress towards it
  • A clear communicator - You’re capable of explaining things regardless of whether it’s to a software engineer, salesperson, customer support agent or CEO


What we can offer you

As well as a competitive salary of circa £100,000 per annum, we offer a comprehensive benefits package, covering a variety of areas, both professional and personal. These benefits include:  

  • Hybrid working style, with the expectation of two days in the office (with a great City of London office base!)
  • Family friendly benefits including paid parental leave policies
  • An extensive health insurance policy for you, with an option to add your family members 
  • A workplace pension with Hargreaves Lansdown 
  • Life insurance of 4 x your salary 
  • Weekly self-development time to spend exploring your professional development interests
  • 25 days of annual leave (plus bank holidays), your birthday off, and an opportunity to buy up to 5 days annual leave per year
  • A holistic wellbeing support plan encompassing a variety of offerings to assist you. We provide you with a monthly £50 allowance to fund activities to best support your wellbeing as well as workshops and training to provide tools and guidance. Additionally, there is a wide-ranging employee assistance programme available to advise on personal, family or financial matters, and fun social events during the year.


The application process

We have a simple 3 stage application process: 

  1. 30-minute phone call with the hiring manager
  2. 1 hour interview and presentation
  3. HR and Bar Raiser Interview 
 
Smartnumbers is committed to promoting equal opportunities in employment. You will receive equal treatment regardless of age, disability, neurodiversity, gender, gender identity, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation. We welcome all applications for this role.  
 
We are committed to providing reasonable support/adjustments in our recruiting processes. If you need support, please reach out to the hiring contact.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager with real technical depth and an AI-first way of working. You'll own a product area end to end: finding problems worth solving, shaping the solution, taking it from 0 to 1 and growing it from there.
You understand architecture, you've written code, you know how databases work, and you speak engineering fluently. Your main job is product. The technical depth is what lets you move faster and make better calls.
AI isn't a feature we're adding. It's how we work and how we build. Expect roughly 70% product and 30% engineering, with full accountability for results.


Your Mission

  • Product direction: set the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area. Decide what to build, why, and how success is measured.
  • 0-to-1 delivery: take new products and features from problem discovery to launch and iteration.
  • Discovery and validation: work directly with users and data to understand real problems, not assumed ones. Run interviews, usability tests and experiments before committing to build.
  • Metrics and outcomes: define, instrument and track the KPIs for your area. Use product analytics to find friction, prioritise the highest-impact work, and shut down what doesn't work.
  • Engineering partnership: understand architectural trade-offs, review technical approaches and unblock decisions. Write specs engineers actually want to read: clear, technical and opinionated.
  • AI and automation: find where LLMs and agents create real product value, build the case, and ship it.
  • Fast prototyping: validate ideas with AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, agents), scripts, no-code, or whatever gets you to the answer quickest.
  • Hands-on work: write queries, dig into data pipelines, spin up prototypes, and open a PR when it makes sense.
  • Prioritisation: balance user impact, business value, effort and regulatory constraints, and work closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics and business owners to ship continuously.


Your Profile

  • 5+ years in product management or product engineering with strong technical involvement, and a track record of taking products from 0 to live use with real users.
  • AI-native: you use LLMs, vibe coding and agents daily, and you've applied LLMs or agentic AI to real products.
  • Strong in Python or a similar language, enough to build things yourself. Comfortable with SQL, git, databases and evaluating system architecture.
  • Fluent in product analytics and research: you define metrics, read data yourself, and validate through interviews, usability testing and experiments.
  • Strong grasp of UX. You can take a complex flow and make it simple.
  • Experience shipping with Design and Engineering in an agile environment.
  • Clear communicator in English and self-directed. You can explain technical decisions to non-technical people, write specs engineers respect, and don't wait to be told what matters.

Nice to Have
  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical field.
  • Experience in fintech or another regulated industry.
  • Early-stage startup background.
  • Hands-on LLM orchestration or prompt engineering.
  • Background in software engineering, QA or product analytics.


Why Join Vivid?

  • We have a hybrid model in our Limassol and Berlin offices, or fully remote outside office locations. 
  • We support relocation to Cyprus (visa, package) when needed.
  • AI-first culture – we use it every day, not just talk about it.
  • Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. 
  • Fully paid vacation and sick leave. 
  • Sports compensation. 
  • Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one.


Compensation range

Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.


About Vivid

At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.

Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.

Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started.

We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

jobs.title: Security Engineer (Hybrid or Remote)
jobs.description:
About The Role

We’re looking for a Security Engineer to own and improve the security of our internal environment — the identities, SaaS apps, endpoints, AI tooling, and networks our employees use every day. This is a hands-on senior role: we expect you to design controls, find the gaps, and drive the changes that close them — and to build the automation that makes it scale.

We’re an EMI-licensed fintech in a fully cloud-native AWS environment, we use AI heavily, and we’re growing fast. We need someone who can lead technical initiatives independently, influence our security architecture, challenge approaches that no longer fit, and explain it clearly to engineers and leadership.


Your Mission

Detection & Response (SIEM) — our top priority

  • Own SIEM alerting end-to-end: ship logs from endpoints, IdP, VPN, SaaS, and cloud; write and tune detection rules; cut false positives.
  • Act as first responder for security incidents — investigate, contain, drive to closure with clear runbooks — and feed recurring issues back into preventive controls.
Identity, Access & SaaS
  • Administer the IdP (SSO via SAML/OIDC, MFA, conditional access) and run access recertification end-to-end across IdP, SaaS, AWS, and internal tools — scope, evidence, follow-through on revocations.
  • Hunt down over-permissive and stale access, enforce least privilege and PAM, catch SoD gaps, and make JML and third-party access work in practice.
  • Improve SaaS security posture (Google/Microsoft, Slack, GitHub, others) and apply DLP controls to limit data leakage.
Endpoint, Email & Phishing Defense
  • Keep the endpoint stack healthy and well-tuned — MDM, XDR/AV, device-compliance checks for VPN/ZTNA — and define posture requirements (disk encryption, EDR present, OS version) with automated remediation.
  • Defend against phishing and spoofing — secure email gateway rules, DMARC/SPF/DKIM — and run phishing simulations and security awareness, acting on the results.
Automation & Ownership
  • Build internal tooling and automate repetitive operations — reduce manual work, don't just operate it.
  • Own the roadmap for your areas: identify gaps, lead initiatives independently, and raise the bar rather than just maintain it.

jobs.title: Senior Manager / Lead FP&AI (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
About ALVA Energie

At ALVA Energie, we’re driving the energy transition forward! With solar operator models for apartment buildings and commercial properties, we offer a comprehensive, worry-free package: from installation and management to the operation of PV systems as an energy supplier. Our goal is to make the decentralized energy transition simple and accessible. 🌞

As a growing startup in Berlin, we value teamwork, responsibility, and active participation. Everyone has the opportunity to actively contribute to our growth and share their ideas. Together, we’re working toward a sustainable future. 🚀

About your role

We think: impact over headcount! At our company, FP&A doesn't grow with the volume of work, but with its impact on the business. Data preparation, variance commentary and standard reports belong to automation and agents. Our people's time belongs to what machines can't do: judgment, model logic, challenge and decisions. If an additional hire enables significantly more impact, we grow. But never to absorb manual work that is better built than distributed.

You are the first dedicated hire in FP&A, start as an Individual Contributor and work directly with the CFO and management. Our existing models and tools have grown organically and are partly manual. You understand them, keep what works, rebuild the rest and automate consistently. With AI agents, you build the leverage that elsewhere would take an entire team.

Outlook: The path to Head of FP&A is open, but not planned for the short term. Your responsibility grows with the impact you create, not with team size.

Your responsibilities

As the Senior Manager / Lead FP&AI (m/w/d), you will drive financial planning, analysis, and artificial intelligence initiatives to support our growing operations.

  • Rebuild the FP&A foundation: current-state assessment, target architecture, budget, rolling forecast and multi-year planning

  • Build and maintain integrated, driver-based financial models (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) for projects, the portfolio and the group, including multi-entity planning and intercompany

  • Develop the KPI framework and prepare management, board, investor and bank reporting with clear recommendations for action

  • Run scenario and sensitivity analyses and conduct deep dives on investments, financing, pricing and portfolio prioritization

  • Build and operate agentic AI workflows for forecasting, anomaly detection, variance commentary and reporting, incl. guardrails and governance

  • Close collaboration with the Data Team: you bring the finance logic and are the most demanding user of the data

  • Evaluate and implement suitable FP&A tools and manage tool and AI costs (FinOps)

Preferred Qualifications

  • At least 5+ years of experience in FP&A, controlling or strategic finance, ideally in a high-growth, complex environment

  • Very good financial modeling skills (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) and understanding of complex financial and intercompany structures

  • Experience in rebuilding or redesigning planning and reporting processes, as well as with planning and BI tools

  • Hands-on mentality and enjoyment in building structures yourself

  • Strong communication skills: you convince management, investors, banks and business functions

Ideally you bring:

  • Energy sector experience, ideally solar/renewables, or other project-based business models

  • Multi-entity planning, intercompany and investor/bank reporting

  • Good German language skills

  • Experience with Claude or other AI coding tools and agentic workflows

In addition, we value the following skills:

  • Tech affinity: You see new tools and AI as leverage, not as a threat

  • Openness to change: You approach change positively and with agility

  • Impact mindset: For every analysis, you ask which decision it enables, and for every task: "Does a human need to do this, and where does it create the greatest impact?"

  • Entrepreneurial thinking: You always consider financial decisions in the context of growth, market opportunities and overall strategy

  • Drive to shape: You look at an organically grown Excel model and know what to keep, what to rebuild and what an agent can take over

  • You are motivated by the mission to advance the energy transition

Here’s what you can expect from us:

With your ideas, you’ll have the chance to enrich our dynamic team and actively help shape the future of solar energy at a rapidly growing startup!

  • Flat hierarchies, quick decision-making, and direct communication in a relaxed and positive work environment

  • Creative freedom—with us, you’ll have 100% responsibility for what you do and will have the opportunity to grow through challenges

  • Close collaboration with the founders, leading to a steep learning curve

  • Flexible working hours and the option to work from home ensure a good work-life balance

  • A modern office in the heart of Berlin with excellent BVG transit connections (e.g., Nordbahnhof, Rosenthaler Platz)

  • A fully stocked kitchen with coffee, soft drinks, and snacks available around the clock

  • Regular team lunches and other team events

  • We offer attractive subsidies for Urban Sports Club, a JobRad bike, and public transportation

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff Intern - Germany
jobs.description:
DRYFT

Ideas only change the world when you build them at scale. That’s what Dryft is here for.

Dryft builds models that automate complex human decisions in manufacturing operations. We capture the knowledge of experienced operators across supply chain, production planning, engineering and more, simulate the consequences of their decisions, and use this understanding to help run their business. Our customers include some of the largest robotics, machine and component manufacturers in the world.

We’re a small, talent-dense team with modest roots and a love for the physical world: cars, machines, planes. Our team includes graduates from Stanford, Berkeley, CDTM and TUM, winners of Stanford TreeHacks, recipients of Fulbright & Haniel scholarships, and people who have built everything from robots and race cars to software with millions of downloads.

What matters more to us than credentials is how people work: humility, hard work, speed, kindness, deep customer care, and a willingness to take on problems others avoid. Working at Dryft is hard. You get unusual ownership early on, with real responsibility. But that’s also what makes it one of the biggest learning experiences of your life.

We’re backed by founders and operators behind some of the most legendary tech companies of our time, Tier-1 U.S. venture firms, and board members of global industrial companies.

ERPs ran the physical world for half a century. Dryft is building the intelligence layer that will power the next.

​

THE ROLE

As a Member of Technical Staff Intern, you'll build the system that decides how some of the largest manufacturers in the world operate. That means combining agent-based reasoning with mathematical optimization and simulation on large-scale industrial data.

  • Build agents people trust – when an agent runs a factory's week, the largest industrial companies in the world have to trust it with their critical processes and understand every decision it makes; you build the routing, orchestration and guardrails behind that

  • Ship features end-to-end – you understand the user need, and you get the freedom to build it across the LLM pipeline, infrastructure, backend and frontend, in production in your first weeks

  • Work close to the users – sit with the planners who use it, see what would make their work 10x faster, and build it

You'll own your own features from day one, and what you ship decides what a plant does next week.

​

YOU

  • Full-stack shipper – you've shipped production code end-to-end, you build scalable backend and infra that handles massive amounts of structured and unstructured data, and you build the interface that makes it usable

  • Highly technical – you've built something technically hard, and you can walk us through every decision behind it

  • Product sense – you spot the feature hiding in a user's complaint, and you've deleted your own favorite one because nobody used it

  • You care about getting it right – you know when it has to be 100% and when to keep it simple, and when it matters, you're still chasing the root cause at 2am

  • Sense of urgency – you'd rather ship it tonight than sleep on an open PR

  • Language – you're fully fluent in German and English

  • Relocation – you're ready to work onsite in Munich (we support visa)

​

TECH STACK

  • FE (TypeScript): React, Chakra UI v3, TanStack Router, TanStack Query, Vite

  • BE (Python): FastAPI with Pydantic v2, Temporal, Postgres with pgvector, dagster

  • AI: Pydantic AI, Langfuse

The EMEA B2B Marketing team translates global priorities into regionally relevant programmes that drive awareness, consideration, pipeline, adoption, and long-term customer trust. We partner closely with Sales and GTM, Product Marketing, Developer Marketing and Relations, Field and Executive Marketing, Content, Customer Marketing, Partner Marketing, Comms, Creative, Media, Marketing Operations, and regional leadership.

About the Role

We are hiring an FTC B2B Influencer Marketing Lead, EMEA to build and scale OpenAI’s influencer marketing capability across knowledge workers (KW), business decision-makers (BDMs), and developer audiences.

You will own the strategy and hands-on delivery across multiple European markets (working closely with in-market comms & marketing team), with the UK, France, and Germany as the first priorities. You will develop local creator networks, translate regional and global priorities into market-relevant programmes, and build a portfolio that balances sustained creator relationships with high-impact moments around products, campaigns, and events.

This is a zero-to-one builder role as much as an ecosystem and operating-model role. You will create the capability from the ground up: building on the early foundations we have in place, you will be responsible for defining the strategy, securing internal alignment, building the creator and agency network, establishing the operating model, and proving what works before scaling it. You will work with existing agencies, identify and onboard new specialist partners where we have capability or market gaps, partner with PHD to amplify the strongest influencer content, and create the goals, processes, reporting, and success measures needed to run the programme with speed, quality, and accountability. You will partner closely with the B2C influencer lead to define and evolve the measurement framework.

In this role, you will

  • Own the EMEA B2B influencer marketing strategy across KW, BDM, and developer audiences, setting clear audience, market, channel, investment, and outcome priorities.

  • Build a credible bench of developer creators, technical educators, open-source voices, AI builders, and community leaders across Europe, and design programmes that genuinely help developers learn, evaluate, and build.

  • Develop differentiated creator plans for the UK, France, and Germany, balancing regional consistency with local language, culture, platform behaviour, regulation, and audience expectations.

  • Source, evaluate, and build durable relationships with creators who have genuine authority with our priority audiences. Own outreach, briefing, negotiation, contracting, content development, activation, and relationship management.

  • Design curated creator programmes and high-value experiences that deepen relationships over time—such as briefings, product access, learning sessions, roundtables, community moments, and co-created formats—turning the strongest creators into long-term strategic partners rather than one-off campaign participants.

  • Build an always-on creator portfolio alongside launch, event, and campaign activations, choosing the right mix of tutorials, product demonstrations, thought leadership, executive content, social posts, newsletters, podcasts, video, and community formats.

  • Work with existing influencer and marketing agencies to raise the quality and pace of delivery. Identify capability gaps and lead the selection, onboarding, and management of new specialist agencies, including developer-native and market-specific partners.

  • Partner closely with our media agency to build paid amplification strategies for high-performing creator content, including audience targeting, usage rights, creator whitelisting where appropriate, testing, optimisation, and clear organic-versus-paid performance readouts.

  • Partner with our Performance Marketing and Growth teams to develop bespoke influencer content that drives measurable performance and business growth.

  • Operationalise the end-to-end influencer process across intake, creator discovery, due diligence, brand-safety review, scopes of work, contracting, approvals, disclosure and compliance, content calendars, asset management, localisation, paid rights, and post-campaign learning.

  • Set programme and campaign goals upfront. Build a measurement framework that connects creator activity to meaningful audience and business outcomes rather than relying on vanity metrics.

  • Define and report a balanced scorecard by audience and objective, including qualified reach, audience relevance, engagement quality, content completion and saves, traffic, product education, developer activation, adoption signals, and pipeline influence where measurement is appropriate.

  • Establish regular reporting and performance reviews with clear recommendations on which creators, formats, platforms, markets, and investments to scale, improve, or stop.

  • Manage budgets, agency scopes, creator fees, usage rights, and production investment, making disciplined trade-offs and improving efficiency over time.

  • Partner with Product Marketing, Developer Marketing and Relations, Comms, Creative, Legal, Privacy, Brand, Media, regional marketers, and GTM teams to ensure content is technically accurate, locally relevant, compliant, and useful to the audience.

  • Bring creator and community insight back into OpenAI, helping teams understand emerging voices, platform shifts, audience questions, content opportunities, and risks across the European influencer ecosystem.

What success looks like

  • OpenAI has a strong, trusted network of B2B and developer creators across Europe, with meaningful depth in the UK, France, and Germany.

  • Priority creators progress from individual activations into sustained, mutually valuable partnerships, supported by curated programmes and experiences that increase trust, product understanding, and advocacy over time.

  • Developer influencer marketing becomes a repeatable growth and education channel, supported by a healthy pipeline of credible creators and technically valuable content.

  • Teams and agencies use a clear, efficient operating model with defined ownership, faster approvals, strong compliance, reusable tools, and fewer one-off processes.

  • Organic creator programmes and PHD-led paid amplification work as one system, with transparent performance, learning, and investment decisions.

  • Leadership has a reliable view of goals, spend, creator health, market coverage, results, and the programme’s contribution to audience and business outcomes.

You might thrive in this role if you

  • Have 8+ years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, B2B content, developer marketing, or an adjacent discipline, including substantial ownership of influencer programmes.

  • Are deeply plugged into the European creator economy and bring an existing network of relevant creators, agents, managers, platforms, and specialist agencies—particularly in technology, AI, SaaS, developer tools, or adjacent categories.

  • Have a proven track record of building influencer programmes for developer or highly technical audiences. You understand the difference between broad technology reach and genuine developer credibility.

  • Have taken an influencer or creator programme from zero to one, moving from an ambiguous brief to a working strategy, partner ecosystem, operating model, measurement framework, and repeatable programme.

  • Have built curated creator programmes and experiences that develop long-term strategic partnerships, with evidence that sustained relationship-building improved content quality, creator loyalty, audience trust, or business impact.

jobs.title: Head of Product Analytics & Experimentation
jobs.description:
Why qlub

The end of a great meal shouldn't be the slow part. Waiting for the check, finding someone to take payment, splitting a bill by hand. qlub removes that friction. Guests scan a QR code and pay in seconds. No app, no download, no waiting.

From Pay-at-Table and Digital Menus to Order-and-Pay, Payment Links, and SoftPOS terminals, we handle the full payment experience so restaurants can focus on what they do best: great hospitality. Less friction means faster table turnover, smoother operations, and higher profit.

We're a fast-scaling fintech backed by Mastercard, Mubadala, e& and Shorooq. $72M raised, live across multiple markets worldwide, and headcount doubled in the past year. We're building the teams that take us to the next stage.

The role

You'll lead product analytics at qlub and build the experimentation engine behind our growth, scaling to 50+ A/B tests a month. You'll set the standard for how our data is modelled so analytics and AI can trust it, and lead a team of BI analysts working closely with Product, Operations, Tech and Data Engineering.

What you’ll own

  • Own experimentation end to end: configure and scale our existing A/B testing platform, set standards for test design, sample sizing, metrics and guardrails, and review results.

  • Train product managers and operations leads to run sound experiments themselves, and build the playbooks, templates and review rituals that make this routine.

  • Define the analytical data model: entity and event design that joins consistently across product flows, slowly changing dimensions, a semantic layer, and metric definitions.

  • Introduce data contracts and governance standards with Tech and Data Engineering, so that new events and tables are designed correctly from the start.

  • Coach and grow a team of three junior analysts and one senior analyst.

Who you are

  • You've built and scaled an experimentation culture, and you're rigorous on test design while pragmatic about when evidence is enough to decide.

  • You love teaching, turning PMs and ops leads into confident experimenters and growing analysts through direct, kind coaching.

  • You think in systems and care about data models, definitions and governance, because reliable analytics and AI depend on them.

  • You drive change through influence and clear reasoning, partnering well across Product, Operations, Tech and Data Engineering.

  • You communicate clearly with executives and non-technical stakeholders, and you're excited to bring an AI-first approach to analytics in a fast-moving, global fintech.

What you’ll need

  • 5+ years in analytics or data science, including time at a large data-driven company (e.g. Delivery Hero, Uber, Amazon, Meta, Booking) or a modern data or experimentation platform (e.g. Sigma, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Statsig, Optimizely).

  • Hands-on experience building or scaling an experimentation programme, with solid statistics: power analysis, variance reduction, sequential testing, and common pitfalls.

  • Strong data modelling: dimensional modelling, SCDs, event schema design, dbt, and SQL at a high level.

  • A track record of driving change: introducing new practices into organisations and getting non-technical teams to adopt them.

  • Clear communication with executives and with non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to have

  • Data science and predictive modelling, including forecasting.

  • Experience building an AI-first data stack and taking an AI-first approach to analytical problems.

  • Data governance frameworks, marketing analytics and attribution.

  • Experience with tools and technologies such as dbt, Airflow, Git, Google Cloud Storage (GCS), BigQuery, or ClickHouse.

  • Familiarity with data governance and cataloguing tools such as Atlan, Alation, or OpenMetadata.

What we offer

• Real ownership over products that impact millions of diners and thousands of restaurants globally

• The opportunity to solve challenging problems in payments, hospitality, and customer experience

• A fast-moving environment where great ideas quickly become reality

• Close collaboration with experienced operators, builders, and industry experts

• A chance to leave a visible mark on one of the fastest-growing restaurant technology companies globally

Ready to build? Join us and help shape how the world pays at the table. If that excites you, apply now.

  • Erfahrung in der Beratung von Patientinnen und Patienten mit Adipositas und gewichtsbezogenen Erkrankungen (inkl. moderner Therapieformen wie GLP-1-Medikamenten).

We provide an integration platform that lets B2B software companies add integrations to their platforms in hours and days instead of weeks and months. Our customers love us because we are innovative, quick, friendly and provide integrations for systems that others dare not touch.

We are a young dynamic SaaS Startup born in Düsseldorf who believe in working hard and having fun while doing it. You will have the chance to work on all parts of our technology stack and in close collaboration with our customers, to understand their needs and get direct feedback on the changes you ship.

The role

Our platform sits between our customers and dozens of third-party accounting and ERP systems. That makes reliability part of our product. When a call is slow or fails, our customers need to know why, and so do we. You’ll be the senior engineer who owns how our platform runs in production, and you’ll keep building the product alongside the team. You’ll work directly with our CTO, Lennart Svensson, and the wider founder team.

What you will do

Own our Azure infrastructure end-to-end

You know every service, how it’s deployed and what it costs. You’ll tighten what’s there and codify what isn’t. As we scale, you’ll keep the architecture simple: we run on managed services and plan to keep it that way.

Bring real observability to the platform

Metrics, logs, traces and alerts, across our services and the third-party APIs we call. You’ll define what “healthy” means, build the dashboards, and set up alerting and on-call so we catch problems before our clients do. When a mysterious timeout appears, you’re the one who can trace it to its source.

Raise the bar on security and reliability

Fintechs trust us with sensitive financial data. You’ll harden the platform, make sure we can deliver on incident response and SLAs, and keep us audit-ready as customers ask for certifications like SOC 2 or ISO 27001.

Build product and level up the team

You’ll ship features and integrations with the rest of the engineering team. You’ll also be the go-to person for production debugging, and you’ll mentor our engineers so the whole team gets better at running what we build.

What you bring

  • Experience: 5+ years building and running backend services in production, including real ownership of infrastructure, deployments and incidents.

  • Production debugging: You’ve chased down latency spikes, timeouts and flaky dependencies, and you know how to go from “something is slow” to the root cause.

  • Azure: Solid hands-on experience running production workloads on Azure.

  • Observability: Experience instrumenting services with tracing, structured logging and metrics, ideally with OpenTelemetry or similar.

  • Infrastructure-as-code mindset: You codify infrastructure rather than clicking through consoles.

  • Security by default: You think about secrets, access management, and compliance as part of the work, not as an afterthought.

  • Backend skills: You’re comfortable writing production code in TypeScript/Node.js and enjoy shipping features, not only keeping the lights on.

  • Pragmatism and mentoring: You pick the simplest setup that works. You enjoy helping less experienced engineers grow, and you’re excited to set the standards for how we run our platform.

What we offer

  • First-hand experience building a fast-growing tech startup

  • Kind teammates and great collaborative atmosphere

  • Steep learning curve and a varied job with interesting projects and technologies

  • Work fully remote or in our office in Düsseldorf

  • Fun offsites where the team gets together to work and play

  • One-time allowance for improving your home office

  • Subsidized Urban Sports Club membership

  • 30 days of PTO + Local holidays

jobs.title: Technischer Projektmanager (m/w/d) – Industrial Innovation & Systems Integration
jobs.description:
Gemeinsam aus industriellen Herausforderungen neue Lösungen entwickeln.

Wie gestalten wir die Fabrik der Zukunft – mit zuverlässigeren Produktionsprozessen, intelligenter Automatisierung, höherer Effizienz und flexibleren Fertigungssystemen? Welche Technologien schaffen dabei einen echten Mehrwert und wie entstehen daraus funktionierende Lösungen?

Beim Smart Systems Hub beantworten wir solche Fragen gemeinsam mit Industrieunternehmen, Entwicklern und Technologiepartnern. In interdisziplinären Teams entwickeln und erproben wir innovative Lösungen – von der ersten Idee bis zum funktionsfähigen Prototypen.

Dafür suchen wir dich: einen technisch versierten Projektmanager (m/w/d), der industrielle Problemstellungen versteht, unterschiedliche Perspektiven zusammenbringt und technische Innovationsprojekte mitgestaltet und vorantreibt.

Über uns

Der Smart Systems Hub in Dresden ist ein Co-Innovationszentrum für industrielle Automatisierung und Digitalisierung. Gemeinsam mit Unternehmen, Forschungseinrichtungen und Technologiepartnern entwickeln und erproben wir neue Lösungen für die vernetzte Produktion.

Unsere Projekte verbinden Technologien aus den Bereichen Software, Hardware, Industrial IoT, Datenökosysteme, Robotik und künstliche Intelligenz.

Deine Rolle bei uns

Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle zwischen Industriekunden, Engineering und Technologiepartnern. Dabei verbindest du technisches Projektmanagement mit Requirements Engineering, Systemverständnis und einer ausgeprägten Hands-on-Mentalität.

Dein Arbeitsalltag ist vielfältig: Mal begleitest du ein mehrmonatiges Entwicklungsprojekt, mal konzipierst du einen Technologiesprint, baust gemeinsam mit dem Team einen Demonstrator auf oder unterstützt einen dreitägigen Thin[gk]athon.

Deine Aufgaben in der technischen Projektleitung

  • Industrielle Entwicklungsprojekte leiten: Du koordinierst gemeinsam mit Kunden und Entwicklungsteams mehrmonatige Projekte mit passenden agilen oder hybriden Vorgehensweisen – von der Anforderungsanalyse über die technische Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung und Validierung.

  • Technologiesprints gestalten: Du strukturierst industrielle Use Cases, bewertest technologische Lösungsoptionen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Teams erste Lösungsansätze und Prototypen.

  • Demonstratoren aufbauen: Du konzipierst mit unseren Technologiepartnern funktionsfähige End-to-End-Demonstratoren und integrierst dabei auch selbst Hardware, Software, Schnittstellen und bestehende Open-Source-Komponenten.

  • Co-Innovationsformate begleiten: Du bereitest Thin[gk]athons und Hackathons technisch vor, unterstützt Entwicklungsteams und hilfst, innerhalb kurzer Zeit erste funktionierende Lösungen zu realisieren.

  • Anforderungen und Architekturen erarbeiten: Du übersetzt industrielle Problemstellungen gemeinsam mit Kunden und Entwicklern in technische Anforderungen, Systemarchitekturen, Schnittstellen und Datenflüsse.

  • Technologien bewerten: Du recherchierst geeignete Lösungen, vergleichst Standardprodukte und Individualentwicklungen und beurteilst deren Machbarkeit, Integrationsfähigkeit und Entwicklungsaufwand.

  • Entwicklungsteams fachlich begleiten: Du diskutierst technische Entscheidungen auf Augenhöhe mit Spezialisten, erkennst Integrationsrisiken und unterstützt die Umsetzung und Bewertung der Ergebnisse.

  • Projekte voranbringen: Du koordinierst Arbeitspakete, Meilensteine, Ressourcen und Projektpartner, verbindest iterative Entwicklungszyklen mit verlässlicher Planung und sorgst für eine transparente, lösungsorientierte Zusammenarbeit.

Das bringst du mit

  • Ein Studium oder eine Ausbildung in Informatik, Elektrotechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Mechatronik oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Bereich – alternativ entsprechende praktische Erfahrung.

  • Erfahrung in der agilen oder hybriden Leitung technischer Entwicklungs-, Integrations- oder Innovationsprojekte sowie in der Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden und interdisziplinären Teams.

  • Ein ausgeprägtes technisches Systemverständnis und Kenntnisse moderner industrieller IT-/OT-Architekturen – vom Shopfloor über Maschinensteuerungen, SCADA und MES bis zu ERP-, Edge- und Cloud-Systemen. Du kannst deren Zusammenspiel sowie Hardware-, Software- und Datenarchitekturen schnell erfassen und verständlich darstellen.

  • Kenntnisse im Requirements Engineering und die Fähigkeit, aus Kundenanforderungen technische Lösungsansätze abzuleiten.

  • Solide Grundlagen in Softwareentwicklung, industrieller Netzwerk- und IoT-Konnektivität sowie Systemintegration. Du verstehst das Zusammenspiel von Softwarekomponenten, APIs und Schnittstellen und kannst bestehende Frameworks und Open-Source-Bausteine nutzen, um einfache Anwendungen und technische Prototypen selbst umzusetzen.

  • Technologische Neugier, Eigeninitiative und Freude an der praktischen Umsetzung. Du kannst auch bei unklaren oder widersprüchlichen Anforderungen strukturiert und handlungsfähig bleiben, Annahmen überprüfen und Lösungswege an neue Erkenntnisse anpassen. Du nutzt moderne KI-gestützte Entwicklungswerkzeuge und kannst ihre Ergebnisse kritisch bewerten.

  • Deutsch (C1/Muttersprache) und Englisch (fließend)

Das wäre zusätzlich hilfreich

Besonders hilfreich ist, wenn du Technologien aus den folgenden Bereichen fachlich einordnen, ihre Einsatzmöglichkeiten und Grenzen bewerten und auf industrielle Anwendungsfälle übertragen kannst. Praktische Erfahrung mit einzelnen Technologien ist ein Plus – tiefes Spezialwissen in allen Bereichen erwarten wir nicht.

  • Industrial IoT & Embedded Systems: Sensorik, Mikrocontroller wie ESP32, industrielle Kommunikationsprotokolle wie OPC UA und MQTT sowie Maschinen- und Anlagenintegration.

  • Software & Rapid Prototyping: Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Open-Source-Frameworks und -Bibliotheken wie Angular, React oder Bootstrap sowie Node-RED, REST APIs, Docker und Cloud-Dienste wie AWS oder Azure.

  • Industrielle Zukunftstechnologien: Computer Vision, Industrial AI, Datenräume und Manufacturing-X, Robotik, Simulation oder digitale Zwillinge.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Ein interdisziplinäres Team, ein starkes Technologie- und Industrienetzwerk und viel Raum für eigene Ideen und Gestaltung.

Benefits

Wir möchten, dass du dich bei uns von Anfang an wohlfühlst — fachlich, persönlich und im Arbeitsalltag. Deshalb bieten wir dir neben einem modernen Arbeitsplatz auch attraktive Zusatzleistungen und flexible Rahmenbedingungen.

Mobilität & Arbeitsweg

    Über unser Bikeleasing-Angebot kannst du dein Wunschrad bequem und steuerlich attraktiv leasen — ideal für den Arbeitsweg oder die Freizeit.

Klingt nach dir?

Du musst nicht auf jede technische Frage sofort eine Antwort haben. Aber du hast Freude daran, die richtigen Fragen zu stellen, neue Technologien zu verstehen und gemeinsam mit anderen funktionierende Lösungen zu entwickeln.

jobs.title: Senior OSINT Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Datenna is a fast-growing tech scale-up combining cutting-edge OSINT and AI technologies to provide governments with critical insights into China's techno-economic landscape. Our platform transforms open-source intelligence into actionable insights through advanced data processing and analysis.


The Role: As Senior OSINT Data Analyst you will sit at the core of Datenna’s product operations and act as a domain authority for our data. You will define which foreign-language sources we collect for each region we cover, set and defend the standards that data is held to, and turn complex registry, procurement, and patent material into structured, platform-ready intelligence. You will own major areas of coverage end to end, guide the analysts around you, and be a trusted voice in product decisions. 

 

Your mission at Datenna:

Analysis and data intelligence 

  • Apply deep regional domain knowledge to develop products that identify, map, and classify entities across corporate, academic, defence-industrial, and innovation landscapes, with a focus on state-military-commercial integration, dual-use technologies, state ownership, and technology transfer.

  • Use pattern-recognition skills to connect corporate, state, and military actors, including opaque ownership structures and intermediaries, and generate structured intelligence that feeds directly into Datenna’s platform.

  • Make and defend analytical judgements on entity risk labelling, ownership mapping, and procurement tracking, prioritising platform-ready outputs over long-form research deliverables.

Data Collection, quality and lifecycle management

  • Define and own data collection workstreams end to end: identifying, evaluating, and extracting structured information from non-English sources including corporate registries, procurement portals, patent databases, academic repositories, and state media.

  • Manage data across its full lifecycle, from initial acquisition and parsing through cleaning, enrichment, validation, and delivery into Datenna’s platform, maintaining rigorous standards so that every data point is traceable, accurate, and defensible.

  • Work closely with the Data Lead to set and continuously refine data quality benchmarks, turning observations from collection and testing work into improvements to automated pipelines.


Product development

  • Play a leading role in Datenna’s data-driven product development cycle, contributing regional domain expertise to the design, testing, and refinement of new platform features and data products.

  • Shape how Datenna’s proprietary risk labelling systems evolve, drawing on hands-on OSINT experience to identify edge cases and improve classification accuracy.

  • Map gaps in Datenna’s data coverage against what customers need, and make the case for the sources, methods, and investment required to close them, including the extension of our approach to new regions.


Coordination and collaboration

  • Coordinate between data researchers and software developers to support smooth data processing pipelines, translating analytical requirements into clear technical specifications.

  • Set the methodological standard for OSINT work as the team grows: reviewing outputs, mentoring junior and medior researchers on OSINT tradecraft, and ensuring work meets Datenna’s data quality standards.


What makes you a great candidate:

  • 8-10 years of hands-on OSINT experience, including direct collection, verification, and analysis from non-English open sources such as corporate registries, government procurement portals, patent databases, academic repositories, and state media.

  • Demonstrable experience contributing to data-driven product development, whether through structured dataset creation, analytical input into software features, or validation of intelligence platform outputs.

  • Reading proficiency in Chinese at minimum HSK 4 level or equivalent, together with the ability to independently source, interrogate, and extract structured data from foreign-language materials. Working proficiency in Russian is preferred. 

  • Strong knowledge of at least one region’s corporate sector, innovation ecosystem, defence-industrial base, industrial policy, and the intersection of state, military, and commercial actors, with the ability to identify entity-level connections across Datenna’s key domains and to learn new jurisdictions quickly.

  • Proficiency in both qualitative and quantitative research methods, with experience producing analytical outputs for non-specialist audiences and presenting findings to customers or senior stakeholders.

  • Familiarity with data analysis tools such as Python, R, or SQL, and comfort working with large structured datasets and contributing to data pipelines. Experience with name-matching and transliteration at scale, for example Chinese or Cyrillic, is an advantage.

  • A postgraduate qualification in Area Studies, International Relations, Security Studies, or a related field is preferred.

*Please know that applicants may be subject to a screening process.*

AI is part of how we build

We use AI tools extensively to move faster and raise quality, and we focus our human attention on the work where judgment, creativity, and responsibility matter most. We expect every candidate to be comfortable using AI in their day-to-day work in a responsible manner and to continuously look for better ways to apply it.

  • Lead innovation in OSINT and AI technologies

jobs.title: AI Support Engineer Lead
jobs.description:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

 

At Dust, we're building for a new kind of AI Operator: people who rethink and rebuild how their teams work around AI. Not “how can AI help us do this faster?” but “if AI existed from day one, would we even do this the same way?”

 

As our AI Support Engineering Lead, you'll own how Support is built and scaled at Dust. This is a deeply hands-on role. You'll take on the hardest customer issues when our agents fall short, but your job isn't simply to resolve them. You'll look for the pattern behind each issue and turn what you learn into better agents, automation, tooling, documentation, and product improvements. Over time, you'll help grow the team and shape how Support Engineering operates as Dust scales.

 

You'll define, ship, and continuously iterate on the systems that make this possible: AI agents, automation workflows, classification systems, knowledge systems, and tooling built on top of Dust itself. You'll dogfood the product harder than almost anyone at the company and set the standard for how the rest of the Support Engineering team does the same.

 

We're looking for someone who wants to lead from the work: technically strong, obsessed with building better systems, and excited to shape both the team and the function as we grow.

 

What you'll do

 

Build the AI systems that do the work

  • Set the technical direction for the support stack: what gets automated, in what order, and to what standard. You make the calls, not just the builds.

  • Design, ship, and maintain AI agents and automation workflows that reduce manual support load: think ticket classification, acknowledgment automation, response drafting, incident detection, and proactive user outreach.

  • Identify recurring categories of issues and engineer them out of existence through automation, documentation, prompt iteration, or product feedback.

  • Build and maintain tooling (MCP integrations, Dust agents, internal scripts) that increase the team's capacity without increasing headcount.

  • Define and own the "Support as a Product" backlog. You decide what goes on it, coach the team to execute it, and hold the bar on what shipped means.

 

Run support when the systems fall short

  • Hire, onboard, and develop the support engineers around you. You're not just resolving tickets and building systems, you're growing the people who will.

  • Set the standard for how complex issues get handled at Dust. You take the hardest tickets yourself. The team knows what good looks like because they've watched you do it.

  • Investigate complex issues across logs, code, and internal tooling to identify root causes and provide clear answers to customers.

  • Handle escalated cases with precise, accessible communication for both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Systematically analyze agent-generated responses for inconsistencies and iterate on prompts, documentation, and tooling until human intervention is minimal.

 

Bridge customer pain to product improvements

  • Represent support at the engineering and product level. You synthesize signal, prioritize it, and push it through with enough context that it actually moves things, not just relays it.

  • Build strong working relationships with engineers and customer-facing teams to ensure efficient, high-context escalations.

  • Own the feedback loop end-to-end: when agents fail due to missing or incorrect information, close the gap across engineering, product, and documentation.

 

Requirements

Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same 3 dimensions: Aptitude, Attitude and Agency.

 

Aptitude

  • Function-building experience: You've defined or significantly shaped a support engineering function before: built the operating model, set the standards, hired into the team, or rebuilt a broken process from scratch.

  • High technical aptitude: comfortable reading code, analyzing logs, navigating codebases, and troubleshooting distributed systems. You're not stopped by a stack trace.

  • AI fluency at builder level: track record of building custom agents, automations, or workflows using AI tools (Dust, Cursor, Claude Code, n8n, etc.); not just prompting.

  • Exceptional prioritization: You know what to solve immediately, what to automate, what to escalate, and, critically, what to delegate and to whom. You make these calls for yourself and for the team, fast and without second-guessing.

  • People leadership: You've coached and developed engineers and know how to set expectations, give direct feedback, and raise the performance of the people around you.

  • Bidirectional communication: can translate technical concepts to non-technical audiences and speak technical language fluently with engineers.

  • Build/Run mindset: You believe the best Support Engineering teams don't just resolve issues. They build systems that prevent those issues from recurring.

 

Attitude

  • Builder mentality: You instinctively automate repetitive work rather than accepting inefficient systems, and you hold your team to the same standard.

  • Resilience-empathy paradox: You can absorb customer frustration without taking it personally while still deeply caring about the user experience.

  • Leads by example: You're not above the queue. When something is hard, you take it.

  • Exceptional prioritization: You know what to solve immediately, what to automate, and what to escalate.

  • Thrives in ambiguity: You enjoy building systems from scratch in environments where many processes are still undefined.

  • Low ego, team player: You share knowledge freely and care about the success of the broader team.

 

Agency

  • High ownership: You define what needs to be done as often as you execute it. You don't wait for someone to tell you the function has a gap.

  • Systems-first thinking: You focus on eliminating categories of work, not simply resolving tickets faster. You hold yourself and the team accountable to that distinction.

  • Pattern recognition to repeatability: You turn recurring issues into scalable systems, automations, workflows, or documentation that eliminate future occurrences.

  • Deep investigation instincts: You investigate as far as possible before escalating, providing engineering teams with thoughtful, high-context information when collaboration is needed, and you coach the team to do the same.

 

Even if you don’t meet every requirement above, we still encourage you to apply. We care deeply about curiosity, potential, and determination, and we know exceptional people don’t always fit neatly into a checklist.

 

Benefits & Compensation

  • Competitive compensation based on level and experience

    • 100,000€ - 160,000€

  • Significant equity package at a Sequoia-backed startup

  • Health benefits for you and your dependents

  • New MacBook Pro or Linux machine, monitor, keyboard, etc.

  • Opportunity to travel between our Paris and San Francisco offices

  • Regular team events and off-sites

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

jobs.title: Head of ClinOps Data Management RWD/RWE
jobs.description:
À propos de Lifen

Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales peuvent transformer le système de santé, à condition qu’elles soient accessibles. Mieux les faire circuler, c’est réduire la charge administrative, mieux coordonner les soins et accélérer la recherche clinique.

Depuis 2015, nous développons des solutions qui aident les professionnels de santé à partager les informations médicales et les chercheurs à exploiter des données de santé. Plus de 150 personnes travaillent chez Lifen, depuis nos bureaux et à distance. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé en France.

Notre équipe

L’équipe Clinical Ops intervient au cœur de nos projets de recherche clinique fondés sur des données de santé. Elle transforme des documents médicaux en données structurées, nécessaires à la constitution de cohortes patients et à la préparation des exports utilisés dans nos projets de recherche.

Aujourd’hui, l’équipe structure environ 100 à 200 cas patients par semaine. Notre ambition : tripler cette capacité dans les 9 prochains mois, tout en maintenant un haut niveau de qualité des données.

Pour y parvenir, nous cherchons une personne capable de reprendre le management de l’équipe, mais surtout de piloter le flux de production, d’anticiper la charge et de porter une démarche d’amélioration continue avec les équipes Produit, IA et Engineering.

C’est un rôle à la croisée du management opérationnel, de la RWD et de l’amélioration de processus.

Ce que tu feras chez nous

Ta première mission sera de reprendre le pilotage de la production des cohortes afin d’en améliorer simultanément la qualité, la capacité de traitement et le niveau d’automatisation.

Concrètement, tu seras amené·e à :

  • Manager et faire grandir l’équipe Clinical Ops, en donnant un cadre clair aux priorités et en organisant l’activité quotidienne.

  • Anticiper la charge et piloter la capacité de production afin de limiter les bottlenecks et de mieux absorber les variations de volume.

  • Construire les outils de pilotage nécessaires pour avoir une vision fine du flux : volumes de patients, capacité de traitement, taux d’erreur, points de blocage et charge de l’équipe.

  • Construire et orchestrer une roadmap d’amélioration continue permettant progressivement d’augmenter la capacité de traitement.

  • Porter cette roadmap auprès des équipes Produit, IA et Engineering : rendre les besoins opérationnels visibles, suivre les livrables R&D et créer le rythme nécessaire pour que les améliorations soient effectivement délivrées.

  • Garantir la qualité des cohortes et contribuer à la préparation des exports de données nécessaires aux projets de recherche.

Ce que nous attendrons de toi

Dans les premiers mois, nous attendrons de toi que tu développes une compréhension très fine du flux Clinical Ops : où se trouvent les blocages, comment évolue la charge et quels leviers permettent réellement d'améliorer la production.

Ton succès se mesurera notamment à ta capacité à mettre en place un pilotage fiable de l’activité, à réduire les erreurs et les bottlenecks et à créer, avec les équipes Produit et R&D, un rythme d’amélioration continue suffisamment soutenu pour accompagner notre changement d’échelle.

À horizon 9 mois, l’objectif est clair : passer d’environ 100–200 à 300–600 cas patients structurés par semaine, sans multiplier les ressources par trois.

Ce que nous recherchons

Must-have

Nous chercherons en priorité trois éléments dans ton parcours :

  • Une expérience réussie en startup ou scale-up, dans un environnement où les process, outils et responsabilités restaient à construire.

  • Une expérience concrète de la Real-World Data / Real-World Evidence, idéalement autour de la constitution ou de l'exploitation de cohortes patients.

  • Un background santé ou scientifique te permettant de comprendre les enjeux liés aux données médicales et à la recherche clinique.

Nous attendons également :

  • Une expérience confirmée de management d’équipe opérationnelle.

  • Une expérience de structuration et de pilotage d’une activité complexe à partir de données et de KPI.

  • Une capacité à passer d’un problème opérationnel très concret à un plan d’amélioration structuré.

  • Une expérience de collaboration étroite avec des équipes Produit, Data/IA ou Engineering.

  • Une capacité à faire avancer une roadmap transverse et à créer de l’accountability autour des livrables.

Nice-to-have

  • Un parcours en data management, biostatistiques, épidémiologie ou dans un domaine scientifique proche.

  • Une expérience de structuration de registres, bases de données de santé ou cohortes RWD.

  • Une familiarité avec les enjeux de recherche clinique et les interactions avec les autorités de santé.

  • Une bonne compréhension des usages de l’IA et de l’ingénierie appliqués aux données de santé.

Ta manière de travailler

Tu as une vraie “just do it mentality” : face à un problème imparfaitement cadré, tu commences par comprendre les faits, tu structures le problème et tu mets rapidement en place les premières solutions.

Tu es particulièrement à l’aise dans les environnements où il faut créer les outils plutôt que simplement les utiliser. Si le dashboard dont tu as besoin pour piloter ton équipe n’existe pas, tu es capable de le définir et de le mettre en place.

Tu es structuré·e et organisé·e, mais pas bureaucratique. Tu sais entrer suffisamment dans le détail du flux pour comprendre les problèmes réels, tout en gardant une vision d’ensemble et en priorisant ce qui aura le plus d’impact.

Enfin, tu sais faire avancer des équipes sur lesquelles tu n’as pas nécessairement d’autorité hiérarchique. Tu rends les problèmes visibles, explicites les priorités et crées le rythme nécessaire pour transformer les décisions en améliorations concrètes.

Nos valeurs

Embrace Complexity — Tu aimes comprendre un flux de données complexe, en identifier les points de rupture et transformer cette complexité en décisions concrètes.

Bienveillance — Tu accompagnes une équipe au quotidien avec exigence, écoute et clarté.

Real Impact — Tu améliores la qualité et la disponibilité des données qui permettent de faire avancer des projets de recherche clinique.

Process de recrutement

Échange de préqualification avec Laura, Talent Acquisition Manager, 30 minutes. Nous faisons connaissance, revenons sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les grandes lignes du poste. C’est aussi le moment de répondre à tes premières questions sur Lifen, l’équipe et le contexte.

Entretien avec le VP Reasearch, 60 minutes. Nous revenons plus en détail sur ton parcours, ton expérience en RWD et en constitution de cohortes, ainsi que sur ton expérience de management et de pilotage d’activités opérationnelles. L’objectif est aussi de comprendre la manière dont tu structures et fais évoluer une organisation dans un environnement en croissance.

Use Case avec des membres des équipes Clinical Ops et Produit, 60 minutes. À partir de situations concrètes, nous échangeons sur ta manière de structurer une cohorte RWD, d’analyser des problématiques opérationnelles et de construire des plans d’amélioration. Ce sera également l’occasion d’aborder la manière dont tu gères les enjeux humains et la collaboration avec des équipes transverses.

Cultural alignment avec deux membres de Lifen, 45 minutes en visio. Ce temps permettra d’échanger sur ta façon de travailler, ton niveau d’autonomie, la collaboration au quotidien et l’adéquation avec nos valeurs.

Compensation: €65K – €75K

jobs.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As Kernel Software Engineer, you own the low-level software platform that sits between our hardware and the flight application on our ground control stations. You work across the Linux kernel, board support and a custom Android build, so that every control, display and data link works reliably in the field. You are the bridge between our hardware and application teams, taking a new product line from board bring-up to mass production.

Responsibilities

  • Bring up, configure and maintain the Linux kernel on our hardware, including device tree, drivers and security patches.

  • Customize and maintain our Android build, covering system services, permissions, boot sequence and OTA updates.

  • Integrate controls, display, touch, battery and radio modules, and expose them cleanly to the application layer.

  • Ensure robust, low-latency SBUS and MAVLink data flows between the controller, the radio and the drone.

  • Debug hardware and software issues alongside electronics and mechanical engineers, using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers and UART/JTAG.

  • Define flashing, provisioning, factory test and release procedures with the production team.

  • Work with QGroundControl engineers and QA to validate system behavior on real hardware.

  • Join field tests and flight sessions to validate your work in real conditions.

Candidate Requirements

  • Master’s degree in Embedded Systems, Software Engineering, Electronics or a related field.

  • 3+ years of experience in embedded software development.

  • Strong command of the Linux kernel (configuration, device tree, drivers, debugging) and of C; C++ is a plus.

  • Hands-on background customizing AOSP, from HALs and system services to the build system.

  • Comfortable at the hardware boundary: UART, SPI, I2C, GPIO, USB, display and touch controllers.

  • Exposure to drones or robotics, including MAVLink or PX4/ArduPilot, is a plus.

  • Hands-on, autonomous and pragmatic, with curiosity about hardware and the ability to learn quickly.

  • Professional English for technical documentation and international collaboration.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

jobs.title: Embedded Engineer
jobs.description:
Accelerating embodied AGI.

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Embedded Engineer, you will own the firmware that runs on that hardware, from the first register write to the moment data leaves the device, so that what reaches our ML team is clean, synchronized, and trustworthy.

What You Will Do

  • Write and own the firmware for our data-capture hardware: sensors, motion-capture rigs, custom IoT setups, and prototype robots.

  • Build real-time data acquisition: drivers, DMA, buffering, and streaming from many sensors at once without dropping a sample.

  • Solve multi-sensor synchronization, calibration, and time-stamping so every data point lines up across devices and modalities.

  • Bring up new boards with our Electrical Engineer and turn fresh hardware into working devices fast.

  • Build the path from device to dataset: communication protocols, on-device logging, and handoff into our data pipeline.

  • Work shoulder to shoulder with ML engineers. Your firmware decides what their training data looks like, and a timing bug can quietly ruin months of data.

  • Make firmware reliable in the field: testing, OTA updates, error handling, and diagnostics that tell us what went wrong.

Requirements

  • Up to 5 years writing production firmware for embedded or IoT systems.

  • Strong C/C++, experience with an RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar), and deep familiarity with microcontrollers (STM32, ESP32, NXP, or similar).

  • Hands-on experience with peripheral interfaces and protocols: SPI, I2C, UART, USB, BLE, CAN, or similar.

  • Experience integrating sensors in firmware: IMUs, cameras, depth sensors, force sensors, or similar.

  • A strong understanding of how firmware decisions affect data quality, especially for EMG/EEG sensing: ADC configuration, sample rate, jitter, filtering, and buffering. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you write code accordingly.

  • Comfortable debugging at the hardware boundary with a logic analyzer, oscilloscope, and debugger.

  • Genuinely curious about ML: you read papers, you have trained at least one model end to end, and you understand that dataset quality beats model architecture choice.

  • High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. You are comfortable in 0-to-1 ambiguity, where the spec is "figure out what the spec should be".

  • Discreet: you handle confidential hardware roadmaps and customer data with care.

  • Fluent in English. German is a plus.

Nice to Have

  • A background in robotics, motion capture, or wearable devices.

  • Experience with real-time or hard-deadline systems: audio, video sync, or robotic control loops.

  • Experience with embedded Linux, time-sync protocols (PTP or similar), or low-power design.

  • Familiarity with ML training pipelines. Even if you don't run them, you can read a training script.

  • Open-source firmware contributions.

  • Experience taking firmware from prototype to small-batch production: test fixtures, provisioning, and certification support.

Who Will Thrive at MicroAGI

Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

  • Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

  • Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

  • Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

  • Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if:

  • You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

  • You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.

  • You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

This is not for you if:

  • You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5.

  • You would forward output you cannot explain.

  • "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer.

How We Hire

We read every application and reply within five working days.

  1. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways.

  2. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes.

  3. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

  4. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO.

  5. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem.

Then a decision, usually within a few days.

Pay Transparency

Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting.
